title: Ceremony Rehearsal Checklist Freshness
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:checklist owner=* last_review_epoch=* rehearsal_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((rehearsal_epoch-last_review_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by owner
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures rehearsal-checklist freshness by owner for ceremony rehearsal prep.
value: Lag tracking shows which owner create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside ceremony rehearsal prep.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `rehearsal-checklist freshness` on `event:checklist` events and aggregate them by `owner`.
visualization: Table of owner with average and worst rehearsal-checklist freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long things take for each owner so you can see where ceremony rehearsal prep slows down.
